## History

Fiske was a traveling [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) evangelist who previously held revival meetings in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) five years earlier, during which he pretended to be a [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) minister.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P7](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0007)_
